title: Codebase Structure — Project Map
description: Machine-readable project structure for AI agents. Maps directories, key files, and their purposes.

backend.description: FastAPI backend — ComfyUI management, audio analysis, 3D generation, GPU operations

structure.app/main.py: FastAPI app factory, router registration, lifespan
structure.app/api/outputs.py: Output file listing, rename, delete, duplicates
structure.app/api/docs.py: Documentation serving API for vault + JSON manifests
structure.app/api/data.py: Prompts, audio files, visuals, sessions, tracks, preferences

frontend.description: React + Vite + Tailwind CSS frontend with Remotion for video compositing

structure.src/features/dashboard/Dashboard.tsx: Main dashboard — drop zone, quick actions
structure.src/features/music-video/MusicVideoWizar: 5-step wizard — no mocks, real API calls
structure.src/features/music-video/MusicVideo.tsx: Music video player — beat detection, audio analysis
structure.src/features/studio3d/Studio3D.tsx: 3D generation UI — prompt examples, pipeline bridge
structure.src/features/visualizer/Visualizer.tsx: Audio visualizer — real AnalyserNode, file upload
Media browser — covers, sort, group, rename, duplicates
structure.src/features/docs/Documentation.tsx: Doc viewer — live vault rendering, JSON formatting

mcp_bridges.mcp/unity-mcp-bridge.mjs: Node.js MCP server for Unity editor (stdio → REST)
mcp_bridges.blender_mcp_addon.py: Blender addon for MCP protocol (v1.5, port 9876)
mcp_bridges.analyze_and_sync.py: GPU audio analysis → beat-synced JSON for Unity

config.config/ports.json: Dynamic port configuration (backend, frontend, ComfyUI, Unity)
config.config/settings.json: AppConfig — host, ports, adapter URLs, output dir, log level
config.opencode.json: MCP server configuration (4 servers: remotion, comfyui, blender, unity)

data_flow.audio_pipeline: MP3/WAV → POST /api/audio/analyze → librosa → beat_times + sections + energy_curve → POST /api/video/generate-section
data_flow.video_pipeline: prompt + audio → JobType.MUSIC_VIDEO → music_video_handler → FFmpeg → output/video/*.mp4
data_flow.3d_pipeline: prompt → ComfyUI (Wan 2.2 5B/14B) or Hunyuan3D-2mini → Blender EEVEE Next → render
data_flow.unity_pipeline: beat_data.json → Unity MCP → AutoCapture.cs → frames → Blender → Remotion
